ios.desc:
Gluon — Projects, Tasks & Calendar

Gluon helps you turn ideas into action. A clean, focused workspace for managing projects, tasks, and your daily schedule — all in one place.

  No account. No login. Just open and start.

  ---
  Everything you need, in one app.

  [v] Create projects with color labels and deadlines
  [v] Add tasks with priorities, tags, and reminders
  [v] Plan events with time, location, and reminders
  [v] Set recurring routines and track your streaks
  [v] View everything on a calendar — week, month, or timeline
  [v] Sync your Apple Calendar to see it all together
  [v] Focus timer with Pomodoro, stopwatch, and timer modes
  [v] Log your mood daily and write journal entries
  [v] Track custom metrics and see progress analytics
  [v] Weekly and monthly review to reflect on your progress
  [v] Attach files and photos to tasks, events, and metrics
  [v] Home screen widgets — today's tasks, calendar, and focus at a glance
  [v] Dark mode and light mode supported
  [v] Works across iPhone, iPad
  [v] icloud store

  Private by design.

  [v] No account required
  [v] Works fully offline
  [v] Your data stays on your device
  [v] Syncs privately via iCloud

  What's next.

  Apple Watch and desktop versions are on the way.
  Join now and grow with Gluon from the start.

quotes.text:
I built Gluon because I was tired of switching between a project manager, a to-do app, and a calendar every day.

  Gluon combines all three. The core idea is the Impact Score — each task gets a 1–10 score so you prioritize by importance, not just deadlines.

  Features:
  - Projects with task tracking and completion rates
  - Calendar view with tasks and events side by side
  - Location-based reminders (arrive/leave a place)
  - Productivity stats with streak tracking and weekly insights

  Available on iOS. Free to download with a Pro plan for advanced stats.

  Would love any feedback — especially on the Impact Score concept. Is this something you'd actually use?
